name: Rumble City
detailed_description:
We created an action packed party fighter experience that you and your friends are sure to enjoy! Our vision for Rumble City was to make the game feel snappy and fluid while adding the goofy over the top elements such as destructive weapons and a cartoony atmosphere!

Features

  • Action packed gameplay: Find tons of unique weapons and hone them to take down your friends! Each game of Rumble City is fast paced with the characters having low health so every jump, dodge, and attack counts!

  • Precise Platforming: What would a party fighter be without some presice platforming? Rumble City has tons of unique stages with many different weapons scattered around. Climb and jump faster then your friends to collect weapons and defeat them!

  • Multi-Stage Games: Each game of Rumble City offers a unique experience to players. There is no "lives", or "stock", instead, each game is a high stakes tug-of-war style challenge. Win and you progress, lose and you regress, until one team pushes the other out of the back alleys of Rumble City!

What to expect in Rumble City

  • Action party fighter combat.

  • Tons of unique weapons to choose from.

  • Achievements for killing your friends in creative ways.

  • A killer soundtrack to rock out to.

  • Lots of colors and teams to play as.

  • (Optional) Bragging rights for beating your friends.

short_description: Get ready to Rumble in Rumble City! An action packed fast paced party fighter where you and your friends can find exciting and creative ways to earn bragging rights by blowing each other up!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 5000 or equivalent) or a dedicated GPU with DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound
  • VR Support: Not natively supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 570 or equivalent) with DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound
  • VR Support: Not natively supported
